why: No major reviewer (RTINGS, Wirecutter, etc.) covers vertical stands here; Macworld and BestProducts are on tilted risers. The consensus pick (OMOTON adjustable, with Twelve South BookArc and Satechi as premium) comes only from affiliate listicles that rank by Amazon ratings or manufacturer specs. Desk & Dowel is the one niche comparison with specific slot-range data, which lifts this above open, but nothing has credible hands-on testing of stability, fit, or heat.
